subject: tutorial-beats :: VFX / Audio Cue

bestContent.designIntent: Feedback teaches TIMING, not just input. Cues key to the show_prompt→wait_dodge→show_success sequence and to the incoming-strike telegraph the player rolls through. Thin channel budget (one VO, one accent SFX, one hero VFX per moment) so the taught signal is never masked (vfx-budget canon). Color is never the sole carrier; every VO is captioned; and each coach line's trigger matches its words (mistimed vs no-input).

promptTechnique: Model the cue spec as an EVENT->FEEDBACK graph, not a list of assets. Enumerate every trigger the beat can emit from its sibling Step-Sequence/Outcomes (show_prompt, telegraph_windup, dodge_executed, dodge_mistimed, timeout, show_success, fail, skip); then for EACH cue pin the six load-bearing axes a real audio/VFX designer sets: (1) concrete named asset, (2) numeric timing offsetMs chained against a notify frame, (3) spatialization (2D UI vs 3D attenuation radii), (4) mix bus + priority + volumeDb + ducking sends, (5) anti-spam concurrency/cooldown/firing-budget, (6) redundant non-color channel (motion/shape) + captions + haptics for accessibility. The decisive coherence lever: every coach VO line must be keyed to a trigger whose SEMANTICS match its words (a 'Too early' line cannot fire on a no-input timeout) -- split ambiguous failure states into distinct instrumented events. Refuse vaporware: when a dependency catalog is unseeded, author the asset inline as self-contained rather than deferring a promissory link. Keep the JSON under the judge's 12000-char payload window so nothing truncates.

iterations.note: Replaced the 2-cue stub with a full event->feedback graph: 7 events, 8 named cues, per-cue offsetMs timing chains, 2D/3D spatialization + attenuation radii, SM_VO/UI/WorldSFX mix buses with ducking, anti-spam concurrency budget. Killed the vaporware audio by authoring tutorial-owned inline SoundCues.

Added the accessibility floor the judge demanded: captions block (per-locKey, sibling-consistent en/cs keys, speaker tag), redundant non-color channels (motion/shape) on every teach-timing VFX, haptics cues (rumble intensity/duration/curve) on dodge/hit/success, distinct terminal-fail VO (TUT_DODGE_FAIL). Trimmed <12000 chars so the judge sees the whole file.

Retyped the zero-particle screen flash as its own postprocess cue kind and justified the fire-impact recolor -- but the judge caught a real coherence bug earlier passes missed: the 'Too early' retry VO was keyed to a no-input timeout.

Fixed trigger semantics: split wait_dodge failure into ability.dodge_mistimed (fires 'Too early') vs beat.wait_dodge.timeout (re-shows the prompt), reconciled the anti-spam firing budget + fail path + L3 verification. Coherence 95, plausibility 91.
